de Rolo city Vox Machina frees from the Briarwoods.

How Whitestone connects

  • Location: Tal'Dorei — Whitestone stands in Tal'Dorei.
  • Character: Percival de Rolo — Percy is the de Rolo heir of Whitestone.
  • Faction: Vox Machina — Vox Machina retakes and later calls Whitestone home.
  • Character: Laudna — Laudna was hanged in Whitestone and still carries that city's ghost.

What is Whitestone?

Whitestone is Percy's home city in Tal'Dorei, occupied by the Briarwoods and retaken by Vox Machina in the arc The Legend of Vox Machina later puts on screen.

Key threads lead to Tal'Dorei, Percival de Rolo, Vox Machina and Laudna.
